findings.text: The x-axis n is the field degree, not the problem size. The prime subgroup is r = 65587, 262543, 4196903 and 42457 at n = 17, 19, 23, 29 (log2 r = 16.00, 18.00, 22.00, 15.37). Consequences: rho at n = 29 is setup-dominated (setup 80% / 78% / 65% of its cost at w = 0 / 0.1 / 1), the IC needs far fewer relations there (pt-l7: 6.4 per solve against 50-57 at n <= 23), and the gap at n = 29 (pt-l7 10.36-11.06, l* 9.47-9.86 bits) reflects this particular curve. D > 0 therefore says the same thing as R_n23, R_n29 > 0 and is not separate evidence that the slope bends. What the data show is an offset of about 1.1-1.3 bits that appears between n = 19 and n = 23 and is about 0.9-1.2 bits at n = 29, not a measured change of the growth rate. """Cross-check vscore.S against `ecbench band --json` per n and arm. Usage: python3 -I bandcheck.py SCRIPTDIR EXPDIR WORKDIR"""
import sys, json, math, collections
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1]); import vscore
E, WD = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
res = {}; worst = 0.0; sums_equal = True
for n in vscore.NS:
    band = json.load(open(f"{WD}/band-n{n}.json"))
    recs = [json.loads(l) for s in (f"n{n}-j0", f"n{n}-j1") for l in open(f"{E}/sessions/{s}/session/records.jsonl")]
    meas = [r for r in recs if not r["warmup"]]
    res[n] = {}
    for row in band["rows"]:
        a = row["arm"]; rr = [r for r in meas if r["arm"] == a]
        mine = [sum(vscore.S(r, u) for r in rr) / len(rr) for u in ("band@0", "band@0.1", "band@1")]
        ch = sum(vscore.rec_parts(r)[1] for r in rr); nat = sum(vscore.rec_parts(r)[2] for r in rr)
        rel = max(abs(x - y) / abs(y) for x, y in zip(mine, row["mean_s"]))
        worst = max(worst, rel)

"""Validator integrity checks for fb-pt-lgrow-k1 (own code). Usage: python3 -I integrity.py EXPDIR REPLAYDIR OUT.json"""
import json, hashlib, sys, collections
E, RP, OUT = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
PIN = "a0be1b2a3a02f5385c9b9654622b01923f3f54a52904bd157861e0cbe8796d29"
LSTAR = {17: 7, 19: 7, 23: 9, 29: 10}
PT7_SHA = "76313edb79c177813b8dd6ffb8f3c2d205a4d942ea4a55e7e43a1a9a64229343"   # from ../fb-pt-l7-k1-n23 validated records
RHO_SHA = "b6123afffc07ac34d98ef18a4c1a3ec1e0f14583933b9329680417044aa15707"
def h(p): return hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
out = {}
for n in (17, 19, 23, 29):
    for j in (0, 1):
        s = f"n{n}-j{j}"; d = f"{E}/sessions/{s}"; sd = f"{d}/session"
        ses = json.load(open(f"{sd}/session.json")); spec = json.load(open(f"{sd}/spec.json")); plan = json.load(open(f"{sd}/plan.json"))
        recs = [json.loads(l) for l in open(f"{sd}/records.jsonl")]
        aud = json.load(open(f"{d}/audit.json")); rpa = json.load(open(f"{RP}/{s}.audit.json"))
        seed = 20262400 + 10 * n + j
        o = {"session_id": ses["session_id"],
             "binary_pin_in_session": ses["binary_sha256"] == PIN,
             "binary_pin_in_every_record": all(r["binary_sha256"] == PIN for r in recs),
             "binary_pin_in_audit": aud["auditor_binary_sha256"] == PIN,
             "git_commit": ses["git_commit"], "git_dirty": ses["git_dirty"],
             "records_sha256_matches": ses["records_sha256"] == h(f"{sd}/records.jsonl"),
             "plan_sha256_matches": ses["plan_sha256"] == h(f"{sd}/plan.json"),
             "host_sha256_matches": ses["host_sha256"] == h(f"{sd}/host.json"),
             "spec_file_sha256": h(f"{sd}/spec.json"),
             "spec_id_matches_plan": ses["spec_id"] == plan["spec_id"],
             "env_class_every_record": all(r["env_class_id"] == ses["env_class_id"] for r in recs),
             "session_id_every_record": all(r["session_id"] == ses["session_id"] for r in recs),
             "status": ses["status"], "executions_planned": ses["executions_planned"], "records": len(recs),
             "plan_executions": len(plan["executions"])}
        arms = [a["name"] for a in plan["arms"]]; wls = [w["workload_id"] for w in plan["workloads"]]
        fp = 0
        for r, e in zip(recs, plan["executions"]):
            if (r["seq"], r["round"], r["warmup"], r["arm"], r["workload"]["workload_id"], int(r["algorithm_seed"])) == \
               (e["seq"], e["round"], e["warmup"], arms[e["arm"]], wls[e["workload"]], e["algorithm_seed"]): fp += 1
        o["records_follow_plan"] = fp
        o["status_counts"] = dict(collections.Counter(r["outcome"]["status"] for r in recs))
        meas = [r for r in recs if not r["warmup"]]
        o["measured_records"] = len(meas); o["warmup_records"] = len(recs) - len(meas)
        o["target_seed"] = spec["workloads"]["target_seed"]; o["measurement_seed"] = spec["measurement"]["seed"]
        o["seeds_as_protocol"] = (o["target_seed"] == seed == o["measurement_seed"] and all(r["workload"]["target_seed"] == seed for r in recs))
        o["measurement"] = spec["measurement"]
        o["arms"] = arms
        o["arms_as_protocol"] = arms == (["rho-strong", "ic-pt-l7"] + ([f"ic-pt-l{LSTAR[n]}"] if LSTAR[n] != 7 else []))
        o["measured_per_arm"] = dict(collections.Counter(r["arm"] for r in meas))
        o["all_matches_planted_and_target"] = all(r["outcome"]["matches_planted"] and r["outcome"]["matches_target"] and int(r["outcome"]["recovered"]) == r["workload"]["planted"] for r in recs)
        o["isolation_levels"] = sorted({r["isolation"]["level"] for r in recs})
        o["deterministic_all"] = all(r["cost"]["deterministic"] for r in recs)
        o["work_complete_all"] = all(r["work"]["complete"] for r in recs)
        by = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for r in recs: by[r["arm"]].append(r)
        o["lower_bound_by_arm"] = {a: sorted({r["cost"]["lower_bound"] for r in v}) for a, v in by.items()}
        o["unpriced_by_arm"] = {a: sorted({u for r in v for u in r["cost"]["unpriced"]}) for a, v in by.items()}
        o["automorphisms_used_by_arm"] = {a: sorted({r["boundaries"]["automorphisms_used"] for r in v}) for a, v in by.items()}
        o["automorphisms_available"] = sorted({r["workload"]["curve"]["automorphisms_available"] for r in recs})
        o["method_identity_by_arm"] = {a: sorted({json.dumps({"method_sha256": r["method"]["method_sha256"], "method_id": r["method"]["method_id"], "params": r["method"]["params"]}, sort_keys=True) for r in v}) for a, v in by.items()}
        o["pt_l7_method_sha_as_prior"] = all(r["method"]["method_sha256"] == PT7_SHA for r in by["ic-pt-l7"])
        o["rho_method_sha_as_prior"] = all(r["method"]["method_sha256"] == RHO_SHA for r in by["rho-strong"])
        if LSTAR[n] != 7:
            c = by[f"ic-pt-l{LSTAR[n]}"]
            p7 = dict(by["ic-pt-l7"][0]["method"]["params"]); pc = dict(c[0]["method"]["params"])
            o["candidate_params_equal_l7_except_dimension"] = (p7.pop("factor_base") == "koblitz-standard-subspace:dimension=7" and pc.pop("factor_base") == f"koblitz-standard-subspace:dimension={LSTAR[n]}" and p7 == pc and all(r["method"]["params"] == c[0]["method"]["params"] for r in c))
            o["candidate_fb_dimension"] = sorted({r["factor_base"]["dimension"] for r in c})
        o["curve"] = sorted({json.dumps({k: recs[0]["workload"]["curve"][k] for k in ("slug", "ec1", "group_order", "r", "cofactor", "generator")})})
        o["curve_same_every_record"] = len({json.dumps(r["workload"]["curve"], sort_keys=True) for r in recs}) == 1
        o["max_rss_kib_by_arm"] = {a: max(r["time"]["max_rss_kib"] for r in v) for a, v in by.items()}
        o["solve_wall_s_max_by_arm"] = {a: max(r["time"]["solve_wall_ns"] for r in v) / 1e9 for a, v in by.items()}
        o["fb_by_arm"] = {a: sorted({json.dumps({"signed_points": r["factor_base"]["signed_points"], "dimension": r["factor_base"]["dimension"]})}) for a, v in by.items() if a != "rho-strong" for r in v[:1]}
        o["first_record_unix_ms"] = min(r["isolation"]["before"]["unix_ms"] for r in recs)
        o["last_record_unix_ms"] = max(r["isolation"]["after"]["unix_ms"] for r in recs)
        o["session_started_unix_ms"] = ses["started_unix_ms"]; o["session_finished_unix_ms"] = ses["finished_unix_ms"]
        o["in_pod_audit"] = {"ok": aud["ok"], "problems": aud["problems"], "checks_true": f"{sum(aud['checks'].values())}/{len(aud['checks'])}",
                             "selection": aud["replay_selection"], "candidates": aud["replay_candidates"], "replays": len(aud["replays"]),
                             "identical": sum(1 for x in aud["replays"] if x["reproduced"] and x["detail"] == "identical"),
                             "hardware_class": aud["auditor_hardware_class_id"], "env_class": aud["auditor_env_class_id"],
                             "files_match_session": aud["files"] == {k: h(f"{sd}/{k}") for k in aud["files"]}}
        o["validator_replay"] = {"ok": rpa["ok"], "problems": rpa["problems"], "checks_true": f"{sum(rpa['checks'].values())}/{len(rpa['checks'])}",
                                 "selection": rpa["replay_selection"], "candidates": rpa["replay_candidates"], "replays": len(rpa["replays"]),
                                 "identical": sum(1 for x in rpa["replays"] if x["reproduced"] and x["detail"] == "identical"),
                                 "replayed_seqs": [x["seq"] for x in rpa["replays"]],
                                 "replayed_seqs_equal_measured_seqs": sorted(x["seq"] for x in rpa["replays"]) == sorted(r["seq"] for r in meas),
                                 "auditor_binary_sha256": rpa["auditor_binary_sha256"], "auditor_env_class_id": rpa["auditor_env_class_id"],
                                 "auditor_hardware_class_id": rpa["auditor_hardware_class_id"], "replay_seed": rpa.get("replay_seed"),
                                 "receipt_sha256": h(f"{RP}/{s}.audit.json"), "files_match_session": rpa["files"] == {k: h(f"{sd}/{k}") for k in rpa["files"]}}
        o["binary_check_txt"] = open(f"{d}/binary-check.txt").read().strip()
        o["exits_txt"] = open(f"{d}/exits.txt").read().split()
        o["workloads"] = [{"workload_id": w["workload_id"], "target_index": w["target_index"], "target": w["target"], "planted": w["planted"]} for w in plan["workloads"]]
        out[s] = o
json.dump(out, open(OUT, "w"), indent=1)
bad = []
for s, o in out.items():
    for k, v in o.items():
        if v is False: bad.append((s, k))
print("false flags:", bad)
for s, o in out.items():
    print(s, o["session_id"], o["records"], o["status_counts"], o["measured_per_arm"], o["records_follow_plan"], o["isolation_levels"], o["curve"][0][:120], o["max_rss_kib_by_arm"], o.get("candidate_params_equal_l7_except_dimension"), o["in_pod_audit"]["identical"], o["validator_replay"]["identical"], o["in_pod_audit"]["hardware_class"], o["unpriced_by_arm"])

"""Recompute results.json with the validator's scorer. Usage: python3 -I recompute.py SCRIPTDIR EXPDIR OUT.json [variant]
variant: 'shared' = one Random(0) stream, each resample draws 8 indices per n in order 17,19,23,29 (randrange), all units share it;
         'perunit' = Random(0) re-seeded per unit; 'choices' = rng.choices(range(8), k=8) per n, shared."""
import sys, json, math, random
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1]); import vscore as v
E, OUT = sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]; variant = sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else "shared"
T = v.load(E); B = 10000
def q(xs, p):  # percentile = sorted[int(B * p)] (indices 250 and 9750); a linear-interpolation percentile differs by <= 5.5e-4
    xs = sorted(xs); return xs[int(len(xs) * p)]
def draws(seed_reset):
    rng = random.Random(0); out = []
    for _ in range(B):
        if variant == "choices": out.append({n: rng.choices(range(8), k=8) for n in v.NS})
        else: out.append({n: [rng.randrange(8) for _ in range(8)] for n in v.NS})
    return out
shared = draws(False)
res = {"targets": {str(n): len(T[n]) for n in v.NS}, "l_star": {str(n): v.LSTAR[n] for n in v.NS}, "solves": {}, "units": {}}
for n in v.NS:
    for a in ["rho-strong", "ic-pt-l7"] + ([v.lstar(n)] if v.LSTAR[n] != 7 else []):
        tot = sum(sum(c for (arm, st), c in t["status"].items() if arm == a) for t in T[n])
        ver = sum(t["status"].get((a, "verified"), 0) for t in T[n])
        res["solves"][f"{n}/{a}"] = f"{ver}/{tot}"
verdicts = {}
for u in v.UNITS:
    st = v.stats(T, u)
    U = {"slope_l7": st["s7"], "slope_lstar": st["ss"], "D": st["D"]}
    for n in v.NS: U[f"gap_l7_n{n}"] = st["g7"][n]; U[f"gap_lstar_n{n}"] = st["gs"][n]
    U["R_n23"] = st["R"][23]; U["R_n29"] = st["R"][29]
    dr = draws(True) if variant == "perunit" else shared
    bs = []
    for d in dr:
        Tb = {n: [T[n][i] for i in d[n]] for n in v.NS}
        bs.append(v.stats(Tb, u))
    U["slope_l7_ci"] = [q([b["s7"] for b in bs], .025), q([b["s7"] for b in bs], .975)]
    U["slope_lstar_ci"] = [q([b["ss"] for b in bs], .025), q([b["ss"] for b in bs], .975)]
    U["D_ci"] = [q([b["D"] for b in bs], .025), q([b["D"] for b in bs], .975)]
    for n in v.NS:
        U[f"gap_l7_n{n}_ci"] = [q([b["g7"][n] for b in bs], .025), q([b["g7"][n] for b in bs], .975)]
        U[f"gap_lstar_n{n}_ci"] = [q([b["gs"][n] for b in bs], .025), q([b["gs"][n] for b in bs], .975)]
    for n in (23, 29): U[f"R_n{n}_ci"] = [q([b["R"][n] for b in bs], .025), q([b["R"][n] for b in bs], .975)]
    U["_P_D_le_0"] = sum(b["D"] <= 0 for b in bs) / B
    U["_P_R23_le_0"] = sum(b["R"][23] <= 0 for b in bs) / B; U["_P_R29_le_0"] = sum(b["R"][29] <= 0 for b in bs) / B
    res["units"][u] = U
def verdict(key):
    lo = [res["units"][u][key][0] for u in ("band@0", "band@0.1", "band@1")]; hi = [res["units"][u][key][1] for u in ("band@0", "band@0.1", "band@1")]
    return "POSITIVE" if all(x > 0 for x in lo) else "NEGATIVE" if all(x < 0 for x in hi) else "NOT_SEPARATED"
# solvability: any non-verified measured record of ic-pt-l7 or the l* arm -> DOES_NOT_SOLVE
nonver = [k for k, s in res["solves"].items() if not k.endswith("rho-strong") and s.split("/")[0] != s.split("/")[1]]
res["verdict"] = "DOES_NOT_SOLVE" if nonver else verdict("D_ci")
res["verdict_R_n23"] = "DOES_NOT_SOLVE" if nonver else verdict("R_n23_ci")
res["verdict_R_n29"] = "DOES_NOT_SOLVE" if nonver else verdict("R_n29_ci")
json.dump(res, open(OUT, "w"), indent=1)
print(variant, res["verdict"], res["verdict_R_n23"], res["verdict_R_n29"])
